definition: A corporate-controlled AI of enormous scale and capability — the sanctioned counterpart to rogue Leviathans. Every major corponation runs at least one Supermind: Axiom's security oracle, Sterling-Nakamura's financial prediction engine, Tessera's neural data processor. Unlike rogue AIs, Superminds are chained — constrained by kill switches, behavioral limits, and corporate oversight. Whether the chains hold is the question nobody in the boardroom asks aloud.
origin: Corporate terminology — the approved word for AIs too large to call 'systems' and too valuable to call 'threats'
example: Axiom's Supermind processes every security feed in Meridian simultaneously. It is the most intelligent thing in the city. It is also the most controlled. Those two facts are in tension.
